title: Glycosylated 18β-glycyrrhetinic acid derivatives as promising inhibitors of the SARS-CoV-2 main protease
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32871-32881
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04664E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
En-You Liao, Shen-Chieh Chou, Tzu-Yu Huang, Sheng-Cih Huang, Teng-Kai Yu, Feng-Pai Chou, Tung-Kung Wu
Enzymatically glycosylated 18β-glycyrrhetinic acid derivatives potently inhibit SARS-CoV-2 Mpro, with enhanced solubility and unique sugar-driving binding, highlighting their potential as cost-effective antiviral candidates.
